proposed_fix.description: Temporarily increase the socket connection pool size and trigger a rolling restart to resolve blocking I/O or pool exhaustion causing high latency.
steps: Inspect recommendationservice pod logs and connection pool metrics to confirm socket exhaustion or blocking I/O.
[HUMAN APPROVAL REQUIRED] If exhaustion is confirmed, apply a temporary configuration override to increase the socket connection pool limit.
[HUMAN APPROVAL REQUIRED] Trigger a rolling restart of recommendationservice pods to apply the configuration.
Monitor recommendationservice_latency and recommendationservice_socket metrics for 15 minutes to verify latency returns to baseline.
preconditions: Verify recommendationservice pods are in Running state and accepting traffic.
Confirm the latency spike is not caused by downstream dependency failures by reviewing trace spans.
Ensure a backup of the current service configuration exists for immediate rollback.
proposed_fix.rollback: Revert the configuration override to its original values and perform a rolling restart of recommendationservice pods.
